exposure: WHO-algorithm for HIV vertical transmission risk assessment
modified algorithm including maternal self-reported ART adherence
maternal viral load (VL) result at delivery
outcome: identification of infants eligible for enhanced post-natal prophylaxis
performance of HIV vertical transmission risk assessment algorithms
cohort: The study included infants with perinatal HIV infection and their mothers who were enrolled from May 2018 to May 2020 in Mozambique, South Africa, and Mali.
finding: In the absence of a maternal viral load result, including mothers' self-reported ART adherence at delivery significantly increases the number of infants identified as eligible to receive enhanced post-natal prophylaxis.
